reviews.review_text:

Terrassa, Spain8 contributions

Disappointing experience despite the 4.9 rating
Aug 2026 • Family
Very disappointing experience, especially considering the 4.9 rating.

The problem was not the price, but the service.

Several dishes we wanted were unavailable. There was no sashimi, we were told there was no salmon, and later we saw salmon being served to another table that arrived after us.

Even worse, we ordered Gân Bò skewers and were told they were unavailable, so they were never served. However, when checking the bill afterwards, we discovered that 3 Gân Bò skewers (90,000 VND) had been charged to us anyway.

Some of the food we received was fine, but the overall experience was very disappointing and far below what we expected from such highly rated reviews.
Unfortunately, we would not return.

Written August 13, 2026
